## Description
A clear description of the bug.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Run Winrift
2. Select option '...'
3. See error

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened.

## Environment
- **Windows Version**: (e.g., Windows 11 26H2; include build and x64/ARM64)
- **PowerShell Version**: (run `$PSVersionTable.PSVersion`)
- **Winrift Version**: (shown in window title)
- **Launch channel**: stable release / main / local checkout (include commit if known)
- **Running as Admin**: Yes / No

## Log Output
If applicable, paste relevant lines from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Winrift\logs`.

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots.
